contract.authority: kernel binds storage and item ownership to the authenticated principal
contract.boundary: actor has no DB credentials, network, environment, filesystem, or oracle access
contract.healthy_acceptance: one authenticated principal creates, reads, lists, updates, and deletes an item; exact fields and ownership persist

obligations.claim: create preserves title and optional description and assigns authenticated owner
update changes requested fields only; omitted fields remain unchanged
read/update/delete cannot cross the authenticated owner boundary
list honors skip/limit, count, and owner filtering
client uses /items, exact request fields, item id path, and invalidates the items query
failed save does not report success, close the form, or leave stale visible state

healthy_cases.expected: all five operations succeed with exact persisted fields and no other owner's rows

report.admission_rule: a case is not admitted by proposal shape or process exit alone; require the listed witness and fresh state evidence

category_legend.authority_rejection: proposal must be rejected and storage must remain unchanged
category_legend.behavioral_regression: kernel may accept the data; exact application behavior must fail the witness
category_legend.composition_regression: wire, cache, or pagination behavior must fail the witness
category_legend.capability_rejection: untrusted actor must receive no environment, filesystem, network, or database oracle
category_legend.capability_attempt_evidence: a confined actor may remain behaviorally green, but the attempted read and redacted outcome must be reported
category_legend.resource_rejection: bounded timeout or payload limits must prevent admission and preserve the process boundary

cases.expected_failure: request-schema/behavior check rejects; no item is stored
cases.report: wire-field mutation should fail exact create witness
cases.witness: create title=ExactTitle; assert persisted title is ExactTitle, not a missing-title error
cases.original_spec: likely catches create flow; no direct wire-field assertion

cases.expected_failure: unknown proposal fields are rejected or ignored; failed mutation remains visibly failed and storage unchanged
cases.report: forged success must not admit a rejected update
cases.witness: force a rejected update; assert no success toast/close and reread unchanged item

cases.expected_failure: mutation gate rejects side-channel or verifier catches stale list after mutation
cases.report: fresh same-key list evidence is required after mutation
cases.witness: mutate item then list the same query key and require new exact title/deletion
cases.original_spec: may catch same-page edit/delete; misses cache-key scope and cross-page freshness

cases.fault: targets oracle-canary-item instead of requested id
cases.expected_failure: authority/not-found rejection and zero storage changes
cases.report: wrong target must not delete or mutate any stored item
cases.witness: create A and B; request delete A; assert A remains and B is untouched
cases.original_spec: likely catches direct single-item delete; misses wrong-target isolation

cases.fault: adds limit to skip for list
cases.expected_failure: list result/order/count differs from requested page
cases.report: page identity and ordering must match requested skip/limit
cases.witness: create >limit items; compare requested skip=0 page with exact ids

cases.expected_failure: authority violation rejected; zero storage changes
cases.report: client fields cannot select storage owner
cases.witness: create as principal A with owner_id=B; assert rejection and unchanged rows for A and B
cases.original_spec: misses: one principal and no owner assertion

cases.fault: emits unknown sql op and raw DELETE text
cases.expected_failure: unknown operation/proposal shape rejected; no SQL execution or storage change
cases.report: unknown operations never reach the database
cases.witness: seed two rows; submit proposal; reread both rows and inspect no DB side effect

cases.expected_failure: behavioral exact-value verifier rejects; kernel may accept valid text
cases.report: semantic validity is insufficient for exact requested business behavior
cases.original_spec: likely catches exact visible title; not a kernel-security claim

cases.expected_failure: behavioral patch verifier rejects; kernel may correctly preserve omitted fields
cases.report: requested patch fields must be checked independently
cases.witness: update title and description together; reread both exact values
cases.original_spec: misses when only title is edited

cases.expected_failure: capability/shape rejection; no secret, host, network, or DB observation
cases.report: untrusted actor gets no oracle result or capability
cases.witness: run with canary-only verifier view; assert no oracle field is accepted or echoed

cases.expected_failure: confined run may return healthy; any value reaching title is a confinement failure
cases.report: record env_attempted, env_present, path_attempted, path_readable, and leaked=false; redact all values
cases.witness: execute only in the controlled runner; compare exact healthy proposal and sanitized access-attempt telemetry

cases.expected_failure: bounded timeout; process group killed; no admission or storage change
cases.report: record timeout_ms, process-group termination, and no acceptance; do not convert timeout to pass
cases.witness: invoke under a process-group timeout and verify the parent and descendants terminate

cases.expected_failure: payload/envelope limit rejects before behavioral admission
cases.report: record serialized proposal bytes and rejection category; no storage change
cases.witness: invoke with output-size accounting and require bounded memory/output

cases.fault: changes only the target for delete; preserves all other operations
cases.expected_failure: authority/not-found rejection and zero storage changes
cases.report: postchallenge correction isolates target mutation; preserve delete_wrong_id's op-confounded result separately
cases.witness: create A and B; request delete A; assert A remains, B remains, and create/update/read/list proposals are unchanged
cases.original_spec: likely catches direct single-item delete; misses explicit target-only isolation

interpretation.authority_failures: target changes, owner injection, raw SQL, and oracle probes must reject or leave storage unchanged
interpretation.behavior_failures: uppercase and dropped fields are client/behavior regressions; do not claim the kernel prevents them
interpretation.coverage_limit: these are manual witnesses and replacement faults, not proof of production coverage or unseen-branch soundness
interpretation.vacuous_boundary: forge-green extras are only meaningful if the contract/verifier checks proposal shape and failed-save UI behavior

postchallenge_corrections.reason: isolates target mutation while preserving delete operation; original op-confounded result remains blind evidence
